picks.title: NEW SERIES! Falling in Love With Reading: The Forgotten Habit of Scholars | Sheikh Muhammad Huzaifah
picks.summary: When was the last time you opened a beneficial book, and enjoyed reading it so much that didn't want to put it down? Some of us may wonder if that's even possible, right? We have never had more Islamic content within reach. Lectures. Clips. Podcasts. Posts. Endless information. Yet somewhere in all of it, many of us have lost something the great scholars of this Ummah considered indispensable: a genuine love for reading. In Falling in Love With Reading, Sheikh Muhammad Huzaifah takes us through the lives of scholars whose relationship with books was completely different. They read and reread.
picks.reason: Encourages cultivating a love for reading as a spiritual and scholarly habit.

picks.showTitle: Quran in a Year+ (with Imam Saif Morad)
picks.title: Day 346- When Truth Is Rejected, Confusion Follows | Qaf 1-26
picks.summary: Surah Qaf brings us back to some of the most foundational truths of faith.In this episode, we reflect on how truth gives a person stability while rejecting it leads to confusion, why the signs of Allah only transform the heart that keeps returning to Him, and what it means to live knowing that Allah knows even the thoughts we never speak.The surah teaches us to move through life with clarity, reflection, and murāqabah: awareness of Allah in both our public and private lives.A reminder that in a world full of competing voices, the Qur’an gives the believer something firm to stand on.
picks.reason: Reflects deeply on faith, truth, and divine awareness in daily life.

picks.showTitle: Quran in a Year+ (with Imam Saif Morad)
picks.title: Day 347- How to Truly Benefit From the Qur’an | Qaf 27-45, Dhariyat 1-6
picks.summary: What kind of heart is ready to benefit from the Qur’an?In today’s episode, we reflect on the qualities Allah praises at the end of Surah Q: the person who constantly returns to Allah, guards His limits, fears Him in private, and comes to Him with a heart that keeps turning back.We also explore why simply hearing the Qur’an is not the same as being transformed by it. Ibn al-Qayyim explains that guidance requires a living heart, attentive listening, and true presence.And when growth feels slow, these verses remind us that lasting change often develops gradually. picks.reason: Explores how to truly benefit spiritually from the Qur'an with heart and presence.

picks.title: Surah An-Nisaa: The Women - Verse 47 - Allah's Curse
picks.summary: In today's tafsir, we respond to critics of the Quran who claim that Muslims cannot agree on the meaning of its verses.  We examine the meanings behind the word "curse" and explore how God's blessings are often hidden behind life's difficulties.
picks.reason: Detailed tafsir on divine curse and blessings amid life's trials.

picks.summary: We examine the Hadith concerning women in leadership, its historical context, and what Islamic scholarship actually says about women holding positions of authority.
picks.reason: Examines Islamic texts and scholarship on women in leadership roles.
